title: Verify an overcomplete positive cone while paying its observed residual
statement: For a full-row-rank r-by-q vertex matrix V,q>=r,right inverse L,normalized trace,initial eta>=0 with Veta=e1,and fitted stochastic Khat_z,the exact lift K_z=Khat_z+L(C_zV-VKhat_z) intertwines V K_z=C_zV. The count-residual bound E_z=|L|M_H[|Hhat_zV-Hhat VKhat_z|+D_z|V|+D_H|VKhat_z|] certifies true positivity when Khat_z-E_z>=0.

costs: Conditioning paid through|V|,|L|,M_H and actual observed residual
